name: S3IM
definition: A training paradigm that combines a conventional pixel-wise loss (e.g., MSE or L1) with a Stochastic Structural SIMilarity (S3IM) loss to improve neural field reconstruction quality, particularly for complex details and sparse inputs.
summary: S3IM is a multiplex loss function for neural fields that captures non-local structural similarity by processing multiple data points collectively rather than individually.
